all_as_shared.description: Treat standalone subnets as shared networks

config_path.description: Path to the ISC dhcpd configuration file

crit_count.description: Number of free leases before critical alarm

critical.description: Percentage threshold for critical alarm (supports fractional values)

format.description: Output format: t (text), H (html), c (csv), x (xml), X (extended xml), j (json), J (extended json)

ip_version.description: Force parsing mode: '4' (IPv4) or '6' (IPv6); leave empty for auto

leases_path.description: Path to the ISC dhcpd lease file

limit.description: Limit output using chmod-like string (e.g., '11', '66'); first digit = headers, second = data

minsize.description: Minimum pool size to consider (ignore pools ≤ this size in alarming mode)

output_path.description: File path for output; empty or absent means stdout

perfdata.description: Print performance data in alarming mode

snet_alarms.description: Suppress range alarms that are part of shared networks

sort.description: Sort keys: n (name), i (first ip), m (max), c (cur), p (percent), t (touch), T (t+c), e (t+c perc)

warn_count.description: Number of free leases before warning alarm (2^32 = default IPv4 space)

warning.description: Percentage threshold for warning alarm (supports fractional values like 75.5)
